reference: Backward Euler two-particle modes, equal capacities C, G*dt/C=1. Relative to common ambient define f=T0-Tamb+P*dt/C, b=h*dt/C. Mean of f decays by 1/(1+b), deviations by 1/(3+b). Ambient heat is -b*C times the resulting modal sum. Independent check of local storage against applied, ambient and oriented contact heat.
